title: Edadugula Bandham
overview: A jealous husband who begins to doubt the fidelity of his wife, when his best friend enters their lives. Wife was unable to convince husband that she loves only him. He leaves her, not knowing that she is pregnant with his child. Depressed and confused, husband becomes a homeless wanderer, while wife remarries to provide a secure home for her child. Many years later, the truth dawns on him as he turns up, a broken man, at his own daughter's wedding.
